board_roster_reviewed: Board at listing = 7: Dr. Gu Jing (executive, chairman, founder; not investor-linked); Mr. Han Zhiyong (executive, president, ex-GlobalFoundries; no investor link); Mr. Zhou Zhifeng (non-executive, director since 23 Sep 2019; managing partner of Qiming Venture Partners, whose vehicles QM119/Qiming Rongke/Qiming Rongying are listed Pre-IPO Investors -> LINKED); Ms. Zhan Jing (non-executive, HR manager, Dr. Gu's spouse; not investor-linked); Dr. Jiang Yimin (INED; former CITIC Capital partner until 2016 and director nominated by White Cloud Valley Jun 2013-May 2021, now INED, not currently a nominee); Ms. Zhou Xinru (INED, lawyer; no link); Mr. Chang Eric Jackson (INED, accountant, appointed Jun 2025; no link).
rights_and_timing: Special rights of Pre-IPO Investors under the Shareholders' Agreement include 'appointment rights of observers to the Board' (observer right; no seated observer identified in the prospectus). Rights granted by obliged shareholders terminate upon Listing (redemption right earlier, conditional restoration if no qualified IPO by 31 Dec 2026). No explicit director nomination right stated in the special-rights list; the actual seat evidence is Zhou Zhifeng (non-executive director from the Series C closing date, managing partner of Qiming Venture Partners, Qiming group listed as Pre-IPO Investor) and formerly Jiang Yimin (nominated by White Cloud Valley, ended May 2021). Zhou remains a non-executive Director at listing. The prospectus does not use the word 'nominated' for Zhou; link rests on his stated partnership at Qiming Venture Partners plus the shareholding table label 'Qiming Venture Partners' containing QM119 Limited/Qiming Rongke/Qiming Rongying as Pre-IPO Investors.
